method.scene: Initial inner-system overview, cinematic size, paused scientific time, effects and orbit paths on, asteroid layers off
method.input: One real Orbit camera right button activation per requestAnimationFrame; 40 warm-up then 200 measured intervals
method.startup: Fresh browser context, CDP HTTP cache disabled. Navigation to ready status plus complete initial imagery and clouds; initial balanced profile for every case. Alternate quality is then selected through real UI before warm-up.
method.cpuGpu: Existing renderer diagnostics use rolling last 180 draw/query samples; independent RAF interval uses exactly 200 moving frames. These clocks measure different work.
method.dpr: Identical deviceScaleFactor=1 for both builds and all viewports; phone-size desktop browser, not physical mobile.
method.restrictions: No FPS claim from inverse GPU/CPU duration; no idle RAF measurement; no hardware VRAM total inferred from tracked texture budget.
